key_highlights: Global equity markets stage an intraday rebound after deep tech declines; Dow recovers from an 1,100-point deficit as equal-weighted S&P 500 strengthens.
Nvidia leadership shock: Jensen Huang reinstated as CEO following public apology and disclosures of therapy, amidst an ongoing federal probe and tech turbulence.
Protectionist policy risks surge following Trump proposals for a new wave of tariffs targeting China, the European Union, and other key trading partners.
Wall Street carry trade unwinding intensifies, triggering the worst losing streak in years for the Mexican Peso.
Energy and commodity pressures resurface with climbing oil prices, threatening downstream food inflation, while Australia enacts domestic gas reservation limits.

sectors.trend: Severe volatility driven by a $2 trillion AI rally unwind, Jensen Huang's reinstatement and apology at Nvidia, alongside app store scrutiny.
sectors.implications: Short-term valuation reset offers selective value in beaten-down chipmakers (e.g. Kioxia), though regulatory and governance overhangs persist.

sectors.trend: Margin pressure from rising tariff threats and intensifying Chinese EV competition, prompting production pauses in Europe.
sectors.implications: Legacy automakers face compressed margins and execution challenges across EV platforms amidst rising protectionist trade friction.

sectors.trend: Crude oil rebound and Australian LNG reserve laws constrain supply, while copper rallies on tech demand and gold tests 15-month lows.
sectors.implications: Renewed energy price momentum risks reigniting downstream inflation (grocery/transportation), while copper benefits from long-term infrastructure needs.

sectors.trend: Carry trade unwinds drive FX volatility in emerging markets; corporate credit market sees selective strain and paused bond offerings.
sectors.implications: Tighter cross-border liquidity and higher capital scrutiny challenge leverage finance and debt syndication pipelines.

sectors.trend: Thanksgiving holiday lull, weather disruptions, and higher mortgage burdens weigh on holiday consumer sentiment.
sectors.implications: Holiday shopping demand is bifurcated, with consumers prioritizing essential spending and deep promotional discounts.

key_themes: AI valuation recalibration and governance scrutiny across mega-cap semiconductors
Escalation of global protectionist tariff threats across major trading blocs
Cross-market liquidity tightening from rapid FX carry trade unwinds
Energy price resurgence threatening second-round inflation pass-through
Corporate debt market bifurcation and rising borrowing costs for households and issuers

risk_assessment.risk_factor: New Tariff Escalation and Trade Retaliation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Rotate into domestic-oriented small/mid-caps, hedge multinational supply chain exposures, and reduce direct China/EU trade beta.
Diversify via equal-weighted index strategies (RSP) and reallocate toward attractively valued semiconductor value plays.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: FX Carry Trade Unwind and EM Currency Sell-off
risk_assessment.mitigation: Close unhedged emerging market currency exposure (e.g. Mexican Peso), increase USD cash reserves, and hedge cross-currency swaps.
Maintain tactical long allocations to energy commodities and upstream producers to offset grocery and transport cost pressures.

opportunities.recommendation: Capitalize on oversold semiconductor and hardware valuations
opportunities.rationale: The recent chip rout has made blue-chip hardware and memory manufacturers historically cheap while secular compute tailwinds remain intact.

opportunities.recommendation: Tactical long positioning in industrial metals and copper
opportunities.rationale: Copper rebound reflects critical industrial and data infrastructure demand (orbital data centers, EV grid upgrades) amidst tight physical supplies.

opportunities.recommendation: Defensive consolidation play via tobacco M&A arbitrage
opportunities.rationale: Exploratory buyout talks between Altria, Japan Tobacco, and Imperial Brands provide downside protection and event-driven upside.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Unwind and hedge high-beta emerging market carry trades
defensive_moves.rationale: Carry trade liquidation and proposed US tariffs create heightened asymmetric downside for vulnerable currencies like the Mexican Peso.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight European automotive and tariff-vulnerable cyclicals
defensive_moves.rationale: Stellantis production halts highlight persistent headwinds from aggressive Chinese EV competition and impending transatlantic trade tariffs.

market_outlook.short_term: Volatile and choppy (1-3 months). Markets will navigate Thanksgiving/Black Friday holiday data, ongoing tech sell-off consolidation, and tariff rhetoric.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive (6-12 months). Growth should stabilize as AI infrastructure buildouts normalize and corporate balance sheets absorb tariff adjustments.
key_catalysts: Official policy details and implementation timelines for proposed US tariffs on China and the EU
Clarity on federal probe and corporate governance stability at Nvidia under Jensen Huang
Federal Reserve interest rate trajectory and macroeconomic inflation updates
Post-holiday retail sales figures and consumer debt delinquency metrics
OPEC+ production quota meetings and geopolitical impacts on global crude supply
watch_list: Equal-weighted S&P 500 (RSP) vs. Nasdaq-100 relative performance
USD/MXN exchange rate and emerging market carry trade sentiment indicators
WTI/Brent crude benchmark prices and grocery price inflation pass-through
High-yield and infrastructure credit spreads following halted debt issuances
European automotive factory capacity utilization and EV import market share
